items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: I said to Mr. Acker... He said 'we pay thirty dollars a week.'... I played the off hours... the regular guy... I played five to seven, and the other man seven to nine

ctx.x: And when the boy struck it rich, some rich guy up in New York came around and gave him ten dollars a week and that was big money. And so I said to Mr. Acker, I didn’t like to be presumptuous, but Mr. Acker, how much do you pay? I thought if he said ten dollars a week I might ask for fifteen. He said “we pay thirty dollars a week.” That was big money in 1926. And he said “we have union scale, it’s a dollar an hour, but we don’t have a union but we pay it. And you play five hours a day.” I played the off hours when…
